note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described in the original; the worker is dimorphic, both forms being combined in a single section; synonymic lists, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule reddish brown; rostrum paler than the head; antennal base brown, apex paler; thorax, coxae and femora pale brown; abdominal dorsum dark brown, venter brownish yellow; tibiae and tarsi brownish yellow. Vertex with a pair of setae, base of the rostrum with a pair, the rostrum and its apex with a few setae; anterior margin of the pronotum with minute setae; last 3 abdominal tergites with a few setae, the remainder glabrous; sternites densely setose. Body length 4.0–4.5 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, strongly constricted behind the antennae; almost as wide as long (1.42–1.74 mm including the rostrum, 1.02–1.14 mm excluding the rostrum, maximum width 0.96–1.08 mm, width at the constriction 0.66–0.72 mm; head constriction index, i.e. width at the constriction/head width, 0.667–0.687); in lateral view strongly incurved behind the rostrum, without rostral swelling, occiput distinctly raised; posterior part strongly projecting (posterior bulge 0.36–0.54 mm; head bulge index, i.e. posterior bulge/head length, 0.53–0.58). Rostrum cylindrical, slender; shorter than the head length without rostrum (0.60–0.68 mm long; rostrum length/head length index 0.53–0.68). Fontanelle tube and frontal gland distinct. Eyes suboval, white spots, situated behind the antennae. Antennae very long, 14-segmented; 3rd segment usually more than 2 times the length of the 2nd, 4th slightly shorter than the 3rd. Mandibles reduced, each with a long, dark brown, pointed spine-like process. Thoracic nota with a fine white median longitudinal line. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin and body with short setae; slightly longer than half its width (0.36 mm long, 0.54–0.60 mm wide). Hind tibia 2.40–2.46 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule brown; postclypeus and abdominal tergites dark brown; antennae and pronotum paler; abdominal sternites, tibiae and tarsi straw yellow. Dorsum sparsely pilose, venter densely setose. Body length 3.96–4.26 mm. Head capsule subsquare (1.02 mm to the mandibular base, maximum width 1.14 mm); Y-shaped suture distinct. Frontal plate suboval or slightly elongate, translucent. Antennae 15-segmented; 3rd segment much longer than the 2nd or the 4th. Postclypeus inflated; about half as long as wide. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped; anterior margin without notch; longer than half its width (0.54 mm long, 0.72 mm wide). Minor worker: apart from the smaller body size, the 3rd antennal segment only slightly longer than the 2nd and the 4th subequal in length to the 2nd, as in the major worker; body length 3.72–3.96 mm, head to the mandibular base 0.90–0.96 mm, maximum head width 1.02 mm, pronotum 0.30–0.42 mm long and 0.60–0.66 mm wide.
